title: ASTRALIS + IMPACT Canonical Data Contracts
description: Single cross-language contract for Python (Pydantic v2), TypeScript, and offline data bundles. Every measurement and derived feature references provenance records. Field names and descriptions are English; Russian is allowed only in source comments.

description.description: English description of the seeded anomaly
description.title: Description

source_type.description: SYNTHETIC demo crew must never be presented as real NASA astronauts

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for the daily record
timestamp.title: Timestamp

nasa_references.description: NASA report IDs and document codes
nasa_references.title: Nasa References

generated_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of forecast generation
generated_at_utc.title: Generated At Utc

is_low_confidence.description: True when confidence_score is below the documented threshold
is_low_confidence.title: Is Low Confidence

source_type.description: NASA_REAL for published panels, SYNTHETIC for demo panels

results.description: Analyte -> normalized value in SI units
results.title: Results

value.description: Normalized numeric value; null if missing
value.title: Value

normalized_unit.description: Documented normalized unit; null if ambiguous
normalized_unit.title: Normalized Unit

title.title: Title

description.title: Description
